active_goal.objective: Ship a production-ready Sfora learned-vector-space retrieval library whose deployed image-to-top-k system surpasses the strongest protocol-matched published quality reference on BOTH SOP and DeepFashion In-Shop and is faster end-to-end at matched quality, hardware, cache, batch size and gallery scale. Keep useful Rust/CUDA/CuTile code, exact packed top-k/tie semantics, clean packages, bounded resources and reproducible tests; no paper-only result. Its second control mechanics attempt reached the 8 GiB limit, recorded 378 memory-limit events, and lacked a complete terminal receipt. Candidate training and quality never became eligible.    Encoder adaptation also appears in the completed late-dense and role-matched trials. Their quality failures remain relevant adverse evidence, although their source, split, trainable allocation and objectives differ from accepted concat. “Encoder adaptation has not been tried” would be incorrect. [Late-dense result](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/docs/inshop_late_dense_adaptation_result_2026-09-30.md:3), [role-matched result](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/docs/inshop_role_matched_result_2026-09-30.md:3)

  Require a finite, nonzero gallery contribution and full64 versus accumulated micro16 agreement before clipping. A gallery-detach mutant must fail.
